# RBI Regulatory Archive 1991-2026: Full Agent Directory

Exhaustive link map for AI agents. Every category and every year, 1991-2026.
Converted Markdown files live under data/<Category>/<Year>/<exact PDF stem>.md.
Per-year and per-category index files below are the authoritative navigation layer.

- [README.md](README.md)
- [INDEX.md](INDEX.md)
- [PROGRESS.md](PROGRESS.md)
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [STATE.json](STATE.json)
- [llms.txt](llms.txt)
